_note: English is the source of truth.
home.title: Get paid for approved invoices in days, not months
home.lead: Mapema pays suppliers early on invoices their buyer has approved. The buyer pays on the usual date. Suppliers see every shilling of cost before they accept.
home.step1: Your buyer approves your invoice and signs that it will pay in full on the due date.
home.step2: You see the exact advance, fees and balance, and accept with one tap.
home.step3: Mapema sends 80% of the invoice to your bank account.
home.step4: Your buyer pays Mapema on the due date. You get the balance within 1 business day.
fees.title: What it costs
fees.lead: Two charges, both shown before you accept. If your buyer pays early, you pay less.
fees.discount: Discount fee: interest of {rate}% per 30 days on the advance, only for the days it is outstanding. The amount we quote is the most you will pay.
calc.title: Fee calculator
calc.note: Illustration only. Your offer shows the exact figures for your invoice.
calc.error.min: Invoices must be at least KES 50,000.
buyers.title: Strengthen your supply chain at no cost to your balance sheet
buyers.lead: You keep your payment terms. Your suppliers get paid early from Mapema. You approve invoices and pay one account on the due date.
buyers.p1: Upload or sync approved invoices; a second person confirms them.
buyers.p2: Sign one undertaking per batch to pay in full on the due date, with no set-off.
buyers.p3: See every upcoming payment in one calendar.
suppliers.title: Turn approved invoices into cash
suppliers.lead: No collateral. No paperwork per invoice. You see the full cost before you accept.
suppliers.p1: Join by invitation from your buyer and verify your company once.
suppliers.p2: Choose which invoices to finance. Nothing happens until you accept.
suppliers.p3: If your buyer has not paid 30 days after the due date, Mapema may ask you to repay the advance.
book.title: Book a call
book.name: Your name
book.privacy: I have read the privacy notice and agree that Mapema may contact me about this request.
book.done: Thanks. We will call you within one business day.
cbk.title: Our licence
complaints.title: Make a complaint
complaints.lead: Signed-in customers can complain from their portal. You can also write to complaints@mapema.example or call +254 700 000 000. We acknowledge within 7 days and aim to resolve within 30 days. If you are not satisfied you may escalate to the Central Bank of Kenya.
dp.title: Your data rights
dp.lead: You can ask to see, correct, delete or move your personal data, or object to how we use it. We will verify your identity first.
